verdict.rationale: Mercury's docs claim that its llms.txt index provides 'endpoints in OpenAPI' format for AI agents (mercury-docs-14), and the llms.txt file itself resolves fine (mercury-probe-1). However, a hands-on probe testing all standard OpenAPI spec locations (openapi.json, swagger.json, api/openapi.json, .well-known/openapi.json) returned 404 for all of them (mercury-probe-2), meaning no machine-readable OpenAPI file is actually downloadable at expected locations despite the claim. Missing for 10: a verifiably reachable OpenAPI/JSON schema file, independent confirmation that the 'OpenAPI' format referenced in llms.txt is real and complete, and documentation of the exact URL where it is served.
